ownership: Authenticated owner/admin/editor in current listing owner_workspace_id; private drafts, version checks, immutable publication history, same-request recovery, no transfer of old-owner private drafts.
content_contract: Existing listing/profile remains authoritative for identity, media, contact and services. Design selects arrangement and explicitly authored presentation copy. Booking inventory, prices, tickets, donation destinations and other operational records must use their own authorized tools; design cannot fabricate them.
specialist_delivery: Own four complete public demonstration routes under showcase/<family>/<chosen-slug>/<template>/, with exact source evidence and browser acceptance. Keep section IDs from this contract when applicable; omit unavailable sections. Export reusable layout CSS and a pure rendering module under assets/homes/templates/<family>/ when stable. Do not use one screenshot per design or static fake tool buttons.
publication: Save draft, compare desktop/mobile preview, publish atomically, restore a prior design into draft, explicitly republish. Native clients receive same published schema and section order. Hidden sections remain available to the owner in editor.
editor: Pointer drag and drop plus keyboard move-up/down actions; editable approved text fields, real media preview, save state, conflicts, retry receipt and undo of local edits. Client template choice never grants business ownership.
item_order_contract: Stable IDs of real authorized offering records only; server rejects duplicate or out-of-scope IDs. New offerings absent from saved order remain visible in their default order. Removed offerings are ignored. Reordering never changes price, availability or publication state.
functional_competition: Every template must expose working category-appropriate customer flows and authorized owner controls using shared services. Applies retroactively to the four restaurant entries and to brick-and-mortar businesses. Required gates and scoring: docs/feature-competition.md. A planned, local-only or provider-blocked flow must never be labelled production-ready.
